Also, check for `null `at `SecurityIdentifier.GetFirstTickerAndDate`.

pr_comments:
The actual behavior, i.e. return the latest available map file even when delisted, was intended.

It was explicitly tested here:
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/835c99e55c2ff8ca41d694c608c56e336767d94c/Tests/Engine/DataFeeds/Auxiliary/MapFileResolverTests.cs#L134

Also, `algorithm.AddEquity("AAA", Resolution.Daily);` uses today as date for resolving the map file.

issue_context.title: MapResolver should return null if we ask for a delisted ticker
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
`MapResolver.ResolveMapFile(ticker, date)` should return `null ` if we ask for a ticker delisted before `date`

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
It returns the last `MapFile` with the ticker

#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->
Check the `MapResolver.ResolveMapFile` date logic.

#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->
This test should pass, but it fails in current `master`.
```cs
[Test]
public void ResolvesDelistedSymbolAsNull()
{
	var mapResolver = new MapFileResolver(new List<MapFile>
	{
		new MapFile(
			"amz",
			new List<MapFileRow>
			{
				new MapFileRow(new DateTime(1998, 01, 02), "uwz"),
				new MapFileRow(new DateTime(1998, 09, 11), "uwz"),
				new MapFileRow(new DateTime(2004, 12, 31), "amz")
			}
		)
	});
	var date = new DateTime(2007, 01, 03);
	var ticker = "AMZ";
	Assert.IsNull(mapResolver.ResolveMapFile(ticker, date));
}
```

#### System Information
<!--- Required for Bugs. Include any system specific information, such as OS. -->
Windows

review_comments:
Not sure this is right 🤔 - For the added unit test, add for example `new MapFileRow(new DateTime(2005, 12, 31), "amz")` and should still return `null`, but it doesn't, right?
I think it should directly return `null` in this `if` case, see comment on line 149.
*Maybe we need a new unit test too

> add for example new MapFileRow(new DateTime(2005, 12, 31), "amz") and should still return

Rows in map files with duplicated tickers only makes sense in the first row (listing date).

Adding a new row duplicating `AMZ` wouldn't be a correct test case.
Agreed to directly return `null` on slack, pending change
